## Change

What does this fix or add? Link any related issue.

Update affected documentation. Include a short **Unreleased** changelog entry for
user-visible changes; documentation-only changes, tests, and internal refactors
usually need none. Maintainers handle release versions and dates.

## Local checks

Commands and results, including relevant checks you could not run. Follow
[CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry/blob/main/CLAUDE.md); do not trigger hosted CI.

## Dependencies and provenance

**None added or changed**, or list affected packages, copied/adapted material,
assets, and changes in use: source, version, license, purpose, and known concerns.
For outside contributions, briefly note material AI assistance and the tool used,
if any, and include tool co-author credit on affected commits.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Maintainers complete the compatibility and notice checks.

## First contribution

Use the [Version 1 CLA acceptance statement](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry/blob/main/CLA.md#accept-once)
for an individual or organization; private email acceptance is available.
Maintainers check existing records for returning contributors. Mention coauthors
or changed rights-holder/employer authority; send private details by email.
